## Segment summary
A young man in a workshop demonstrates how to assemble a simple, cube-shaped robot called a "desk-buddy" using three electronic components. He explains that the project requires only four wires per component and can be completed for less than $5. The video uses text overlays and inset images to illustrate the components (IMU, OLED screen, microcontroller) and the I2C communication protocol.

## Segment summary
A person demonstrates two small, cube-shaped robots with LED displays that react to physical interaction. The segment explains how an IMU sensor gives the robot personality by measuring acceleration and rotation, showing examples like dizziness when shaken or happiness when tapped. The presenter also discusses adding speakers and microphones to enhance the robots' capabilities.
